written.headline: Nvidia board creates National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
written.summary: Nvidia's board of directors established a new standing committee to oversee the company's national security policies, export control compliance and global trade risk management. The committee, chaired by director Suzanne Nora Johnson, will meet at least quarterly and retain independent outside experts.

written.headline: OpenAI names Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia
written.summary: Pragya Misra, OpenAI's head of strategy and global affairs in India, will take on a new role leading the company's business development for India and South Asia. She joined OpenAI in April 2024 as its first hire in India, and the company says India is its largest market with over 100 million weekly users.

written.headline: US tightens AI chip export rules, targeting Southeast Asia data centres
written.summary: The US Commerce Department announced new export controls on Nov 16 requiring licenses for AI chip shipments to data centres in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Brazil that may provide compute to Chinese firms. Shares of Southeast Asian data centre and chip supply chain companies fell sharply, with some Malaysian firms dropping nearly 20%.

written.headline: Numa raises $45M Series C to expand AI operating system for car dealerships
written.summary: Oakland‑based Numa secured $45 million in a Series C round led by Blue Cloud Ventures, bringing total funding to $96 million and a post‑money valuation of $500 million. The company now serves more than 1,500 dealerships in the U.S. and Canada.

written.headline: Sarvam AI opens Token Factory to run global open-weight models on Indian servers
written.summary: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, an OpenAI-compatible API that serves its Sarvam 105B model and global open-weight models (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Gemma) on GPU clusters in India, charging by usage. The company says it already serves more than 450 billion DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tokens a day.

written.headline: CertiSum makes MXFP4 training bitwise identical across GPUs and parallelism layouts
written.summary: Researchers at arXiv presented CertiSum, a method that makes 4-bit MXFP4 training bitwise identical across AMD MI350X and NVIDIA GB200 GPUs and across data, tensor, and context parallelism layouts. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments it preserved training states bit for bit, adding 11.8–60.5% to training-step latency at the larger evaluated input shapes.
